text:
Alex M: Heads-up — planning to deploy routing-v3 at 18:00 PT today. Need a quick handoff for dashboards, traces, alerts, and rollback readiness. TL;DR: I'll kick at 18:00 PT, canary 5% for 10m then ramp.

Priya S: I can update the dashboards and add a canary panel. Which metrics are highest priority? p50/p95 latency, qcache hit rate, 5xx rate, and GPU utl. I’ll open a PR to infra-dash.

Jordan K: I’ll run the smoke tests and watch traces at deploy time. Smoke checklist I’ll run: `./scripts/smoke_run.sh --suite=quick` and `./scripts/check_kv_cache.sh`. I’ll paste logs here. Ping me at the moment of deploy.

Lina T: For alerts: I propose temporarily relaxing the 5xx alert from 1% -> 3% for a 20m window post-deploy to avoid noisy pages while canary ramps. I will also route any firing alerts to `eng-oncall` + `ops-oncall`. Also going to bump trace sampling for the canary to 100% for first 5m so we capture spans.

Sam R: Rollback plan: if request_error_rate > 3% for 5m OR p95 latency increases > 200ms sustained for 5m -> rollback to v3.2.0. Rollback command is in the runbook: `kubectl -n infra set image deploy/routing routing=image:v3.2.0 && k rollout restart deploy/routing`. Runbook link: https://go/redwood/runbooks/deploy-rollbacks (internal).

Priya S: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra-dash/pull/842 — updates dashboard panels (+adds canary panel & heartbeat row). Includes the temp alert change and a graph for qcache hit rate by model.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by Alex M: routing-v3 at 2024-04-12T18:00:00-07:00. Canary=5% for 10m then ramp.

oncall-bot: Reminder: eng-oncall notify list will be paged if critical alerts fire.

Jordan K: Quick note — I’ll capture a trace ID example during canary and post it here so infra can correlate. Will also run `k top pod` snapshot after canary start.

Lina T: Alert snippet I’ll apply in alerts repo PR:
```
- alert: High5xxRate
  expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="routing",status=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="routing"}[5m])) > 0.03
  for: 5m
  labels: { severity: "page" }
```
I’ll tag `eng-oncall` and `ops-oncall` in the PR description.

Sam R: I’ll stand by to execute rollback if needed. Also I’ll add a short smoke step to verify the KV cache hits after the rollout: `make smoke-kv-check` which returns <10% miss.

Priya S: Quick review done, adding a canary dashboard link to the PR description. Also added a temporary time-range 15m offset panel so we can focus on the exact window.

Alex M: Thanks all. Plan: T-30 we do a final go/no-go here. If anything suspicious at any point -> abort and rollback. Jordan, Lina, Sam — please have your commands and runbook tabs ready. :thumbsup:

Jordan K: Copy that. I’ll post smoke logs here within 2 minutes of canary start.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: deployment in 30m (routing-v3).

Priya S: :thumbsup: Reviewing dashboards now, will be on standby for quick changes.

Alex M: Ok — see you at T-30. If anyone can’t make the window please call out now so we reschedule.
